function.name: analyze_image
function.description: Analyze an uploaded or generated image using a vision model. Use for image questions, descriptions, OCR, object identification, document reading, or comparing two images. Does not generate or modify images.

query.description: The user's question or request about the image.

analysisType.description: Type of analysis. Use general when answering the user's specific question.

sourceImageIndex.description: Image to analyze. Non-negative indexes refer to generated images; negative indexes refer to uploaded images (-1 first upload, -2 second upload). Omit to auto-select latest image.

compareImageIndex.description: Second image for compare mode, using the same indexing convention as sourceImageIndex.

detailed.description: Whether to provide a more detailed analysis.

function.name: analyze_video
function.description: Analyze an uploaded or generated video using sampled frames and a vision model. Use for video summaries, timelines, visual scene descriptions, action breakdowns, or visible text. Does not generate or modify videos.

query.description: The user's question or request about the video.

analysisType.description: Type of analysis. Use general when answering the user's specific question.

sourceVideoIndex.description: Video to analyze. Non-negative indexes refer to generated videos; negative indexes refer to uploaded videos (-1 first upload, -2 second upload). Omit to auto-select latest video.

detailed.description: Whether to sample more context and provide a more detailed analysis.

function.name: extract_metadata
function.description: Extract available technical metadata from an uploaded or generated media asset. Use when the user asks for duration, dimensions, MIME type, file size, model/prompt/settings metadata, or generation metadata embedded in or attached to a media file. For visual content questions, use analyze_image or analyze_video instead.

mediaType.description: Media type to inspect. Omit when the available context makes it unambiguous.

sourceImageIndex.description: Image to inspect, using generated indexes or negative uploaded indexes.

sourceVideoIndex.description: Video to inspect, using generated indexes or negative uploaded indexes.

audioSourceIndex.description: Audio asset to inspect, using generated indexes or negative uploaded indexes.

fileIndex.description: Legacy 0-based uploaded-file index. Prefer mediaType plus sourceImageIndex/sourceVideoIndex/audioSourceIndex when possible.

function.name: ask_clarifying_question
function.description: Pause the workflow and ask the user a clarifying question. The host treats this as the end of the turn; do not call other tools after it.

question.description: The exact short question to surface to the user.

reason.description: Short telemetry tag explaining why clarification is needed.

function.name: finalize_response
function.description: Mark the turn complete and surface a final assistant message. The host stops the tool loop when this is called. Do not call other tools after finalize_response.

summary.description: Short user-visible summary. Leave empty when prior tool output already says enough.

function.name: create_asset_manifest
function.description: Reset and seed the session asset manifest with stable asset_id values so later tool calls can refer to assets reliably.

assets.description: Ordered list of assets to register.

must_preserve.description: Features to preserve when regenerating from this asset.

function.name: inspect_asset
function.description: Return one asset record by asset_id or user_label, or the full asset manifest when no selector is provided.

function.name: label_asset
function.description: Update labels or preservation notes on an existing asset manifest entry.

description.description: Replacement description. Empty string clears it.

url.description: Replacement URL. Empty string clears it.

function.name: map_assets_for_model
function.description: Return model-specific reference tokens for each asset in the manifest, such as @Image1 for Seedance or Image 1 for GPT Image 2.

function.name: validate_asset_references
function.description: Check whether model-specific asset reference tokens in a prompt resolve to registered manifest assets.
